info.title: ngql
info.description: Command-line tool for NGql — compiles a C# QueryBuilder snippet against NGql.Core and prints the rendered GraphQL. Reads from a file path or stdin. Intended for hand verification of NGql snippets and for use alongside the NGql Claude Code skill.

options.name: --execute
options.description:
After rendering, POST the operation to --endpoint
and print the response
to. Required with --execute

options.name: --endpoint
options.description:
GraphQL endpoint URL to POST the rendered operation
to. Required with --execute

options.name: --header
options.description: HTTP header in 'Name: value' form. Repeatable

options.name: --var
options.description:
GraphQL variable in 'key=value' form. Values are
JSON-parsed when possible (numbers, bools, arrays,
objects); otherwise sent as a string. Repeatable

options.name: --allow-mutations
options.description:
Opt in to executing mutations. Default refuses for
safety; mutations have side effects

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description:
Path to a snippet file, or '-' for stdin (default if no value
provided)
